review.overall_explanation: Reviewed the uncommitted TF-0674 bundle against its callers and consumers. The workspace owner ID and fingerprint now survive immediate and queued FollowupRun dispatch into attempts; the legacy local prompt still uses a directory-shaped scope for prompt construction but is not published into the owner-keyed observation cache; the chat input-mode queue persists and restores the fingerprint through the existing payload_json path and groups claims by agent/workspace/fingerprint/task-root; Gateway stdout is actively drained; and the added unit/E2E assertions exercise the relevant boundaries, including mixed-owner draining and both drain callbacks. I did not find an actionable bug introduced by this change. Inspection was read-only and static: the provided evidence says the latest typecheck and deterministic mixed-owner rerun are still in progress, and the earlier r14 native journey predates the owner fixes, so I have not independently established full E2E or acceptance proof for this exact snapshot.
